g.text: `allmaps.py` · driver: walk every `.bsp` under a hardcoded Windows path, wipe the output dir, write eight report folders
`bsp_parse.py` · the library: lump reader, texture lister, entity-table sound finder
`ignorelist.py` · one-off: turn a resource tree into the two ignore lists
module globals `SILENT`, `LOGGING`, `DEBUG`, `EXISTSCHECK`, `EXISTSPATH` · edited in the source, no flags
magic and version · `IBSP` at offset 0, version at 4, a warning if it is not 46
`grab_lump` · header is 8 B, then 8-byte offset/size pairs, returns a memoryview slice
`dump_textures` · lump 5, 76-byte surface headers, name at +40 as 32 B latin-1, forced to `.m32`
entity table · lump 0 decoded latin-1 and split into lines
`grabField` and `grabFields` · find a classname, walk to its brace, pull one field out
`EXISTSCHECK` · optional `os.path.isfile` against the texture and sound tree of that map
ignore lists · every stock SoF asset filtered out, so only map content remains
`ignore_defaults_tex.txt` · JSON array of lowercased relative texture paths
`bspdata.rar` · 2.6 MB of an earlier report from this tool, committed to the repo
output tree named by the first argument · deleted and rebuilt on every run
`*.bsp` · SoF IBSP v46 maps, in a directory tree the walker mirrors
resource tree `base/textures`, `base/sound` · what EXISTSCHECK stats, at a hardcoded Windows path
Python 3 stdlib only · `struct`, `memoryview`, `json`, `shutil`, nothing to install
a person · reads the report folders and diffs two runs by hand, nothing automates that
two of the twenty-odd lumps are read
one field per classname, two classnames total
one field per classname, two classnames total
only survivors are checked on disk
the driver passes each map path to the library
two ignore lists in, one report tree out
reads maps and optionally stats their assets
